certHighlights.heading: What We Train
certHighlights.intro: Every programme we deliver is backed by a globally recognised certification body — the same qualifications accepted on worksites and by employers worldwide, now available right here in Angola.
certHighlights.card1Desc: Accredited Lead Auditor programmes for Quality (ISO 9001), Environmental (ISO 14001) and Occupational Health & Safety (ISO 45001) management systems — equipping professionals and organisations for audit, compliance and certification.
certHighlights.card2Desc: ISO 9712 Level 2 and Level 3 certification pathways across major technical methods — conventional techniques, advanced methods (PAUT, TOFD) and specialised courses including ACFM and Eddy Current. A trusted benchmark for professional competence.
certHighlights.card3Desc: ASNT-accredited training pathways covering VT, MT, PT, UT, RT and RTFI — a globally recognised standard for technical qualification in the oil, gas and industrial sectors.
certHighlights.card4Desc: Internationally recognised welding and painting certification pathways from TWI — covering visual welding competence (CSWIP 3.0, 3.1, 3.2) and protective coatings expertise (BGAS Grade 1 & 2).
certHighlights.card5Desc: Comprehensive professional development pathways for the oil & gas and industrial sectors, built to globally recognised standards and designed to prepare professionals for advanced technical roles.
certHighlights.card5bDesc: We partner with corporations, EPC contractors and industrial operators to deliver tailored in-company certification and training programmes. From ISO management system development to workforce capability building, we support certified, audit-ready teams that meet project, tender and regulatory requirements.

whyUs.heading: Why Choose ARCO ANGOLA?
whyUs.subtitle: We serve both individual professionals and corporate clients — delivering internationally recognised certifications and tailored training solutions that meet the real demands of Angola's industrial sector.
whyUs.reason1Desc: Our programmes are backed by globally respected bodies such as TWI-CSWIP, ASNT, API, ISO and HSE, giving learners and organisations credentials that are trusted across international markets.
whyUs.reason2Desc: We design scalable training pathways for companies, including in-house delivery, workforce upskilling and organisational capability development aligned with project and compliance needs.
whyUs.reason3Desc: Our instructors bring real-world technical and operational insight from oil & gas, construction and industrial environments, ensuring training stays practical and relevant.
whyUs.reason4Desc: We support learners in English, Portuguese and French, making high-quality certification and professional development accessible across Angola and the wider region.
whyUs.reason5Desc: We provide local delivery, expert guidance and long-term support in Angola, helping clients and learners move confidently from training to recognised competence.
whyUs.reason6Desc: A consistent track record of rigorous quality control and high-standard training delivery, ensuring every certification we issue reflects real, verifiable competence.
whyUs.reason7Desc: We constantly refine our programmes, processes and materials to stay ahead of evolving industry standards and the changing needs of our clients.
whyUs.reason8Desc: We uphold the highest standards of safety, ethics and transparency in everything we do, building trust with every learner, client and partner.

ecosystem.heading: An International Certification Framework. Delivered in Africa.
ecosystem.step2Role: International Academy of NDT — Independent Personnel Certification Body — PCB-124
ecosystem.certNote: IANDT's current certificate identifies it as PCB-124, accredited to ISO/IEC 17024:2012, with an effective date of 22 May 2026.
ecosystem.supportingNote: ARCO ANGOLA delivers the training and education as an Authorised Training Organisation of IANDT in Angola and the wider African market. IANDT, as the independent Personnel Certification Body, retains sole responsibility for personnel certification decisions under its applicable certification scheme.
ecosystem.positioning: ARCO ANGOLA is developing its IANDT-approved Training Organization pathway in Angola, delivering structured NDT training as an Authorised Training Organisation of IANDT, the independent Personnel Certification Body.

about.heading: International NDT Competence
about.body: BS EN ISO 9712:2022 provides an internationally structured framework for the qualification and certification of personnel performing non-destructive testing. ARCO ANGOLA's programme pathway is designed to support NDT professionals through structured training and the applicable independent personnel certification process.
